summary.name: Runway
summary.one_liner: Runway is an AI company offering cloud creative tools for generating and editing video, images and audio, plus a developer API and robotics simulation toolkit built on its world models.
use_cases: edit video and images in one workspace
build apps on video and image models via API
run robot policy inference in simulation
create synthetic training data for robotics
produce marketing content for brands and agencies
summary.what_it_does: Runway describes three platforms built on the same Real-World Intelligence models. Runway Creative is a cloud-based suite for generating and editing video, images and audio in one workspace, aimed at individuals and teams. Runway Dev is an API platform that gives developers access to Runway's models and other labs' models, with tooling to get production-ready output at scale. Runway Robotics is a toolkit for running policy inference and evaluation through photorealistic simulation and generating synthetic data, powered by GWM-1. The page also names Gen-4.5 as its video model and General World Models as a long-term research effort.
notable: Three product lines (Creative, Dev, Robotics) on shared world models
Gen-4.5 video model and GWM-1 General World Model
Developer API with access to models from Runway and other labs
Robotics simulation for policy evaluation and synthetic data
caveats: Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
Robotics toolkit is offered in a form fitted to customer hardware, so access appears to require working with the company
